synthesizedFacts.fact: Pseudoexfoliation syndrome (PXF) is an age-related systemic condition characterized by the accumulation of fibrillar material in various body tissues, particularly affecting the eye.
PXF is associated with an increased risk of glaucoma, particularly pseudoexfoliation glaucoma, due to the blockage of the eye's drainage system.
The exact etiology of PXF is unknown, but genetic factors such as LOXL1 gene polymorphisms and environmental factors like UV exposure may contribute.
Pseudoexfoliation syndrome can complicate cataract surgery due to poor pupil dilation and zonular instability.
